title: Meta turns Muse into an agent for glasses, Macs and commerce
teaser: Meta is turning Muse from a new assistant into the control layer for a user’s digital life. At Connect in Menlo Park, Mark Zuckerberg outlined plans to put the agent in Meta’s smart glasses, let it operate Mac applications, give it an email address and connect it to shopping services. Muse is only a few weeks old, but Meta is already treating it as a central consumer AI product—and building a business model around the transactions it may eventually handle.
